panels.description: The state of the deployment: 0 = healthy, 1 = partial outage, 2 = complete outage. Only models with traffic (success or failure) inside the selected time range are shown
panels.title: Deployment Status

panels.description: Total spend per team, top 10

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (team, team_alias) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))

panels.title: Total Spend per Team

panels.description: Total spend per user, top 10

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user, user_email) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))

panels.title: Total Spend per User

panels.description: Total spend per model, top 10

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (model) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))

panels.title: Total Spend per Model

panels.description: Total spend per user agent, top 10

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_agent) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))

panels.title: Total Spend per User Agent

panels.description: Total latency for a models LLM API call
panels.title: Models Latency

panels.description: Time to first token for a models LLM API call
panels.title: Models Time To First Token Latency

panels.description: Total number of requests made to the proxy server - track number of client side requests

targets.expr: sum by (route, requested_model) (rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", requested_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests Rate

panels.description: Spend on LLM requests

targets.expr: sum by (model, team, team_alias, user, user_email) (rate(litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Spend Rate

panels.description: Rate of input/output tokens from LLM requests

targets.expr: sum by (model, team, team_alias, user, user_email) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (model, team, team_alias, user, user_email) (rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tokens Rate

panels.description: Total number of failed responses from proxy - the client did not get a success response from litellm proxy

panels.title: Failed Requests (top 10)

panels.description: Number of failed fallback requests from primary model -> fallback model

targets.expr: litellm_deployment_failed_fallbacks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}

panels.title: Failed Fallbacks (top 10)

panels.description: Total number of failed responses from proxy - the client did not get a success response from litellm proxy

targets.expr: litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}

panels.title: Failed Requests (Last 25)

panels.description: Number of failed fallback requests from primary model -> fallback model

targets.expr: litellm_deployment_failed_fallbacks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}

panels.title: Failed Fallbacks (Last 25)

panels.description: Raw state of every deployment endpoint: 0 = healthy, 1 = partial outage, 2 = complete outage. Endpoints without api_base (router-side pre-call rejections) are excluded. A model with several deployments (different api_base) can show mixed states while still serving traffic via fallback
panels.title: Deployment State per Endpoint

panels.description: Requests where the primary deployment failed and the router served a fallback instead. The client got a success; the primary's error still shows up in deployment state and failed-request counts

targets.expr: sum by (requested_model, fallback_model, exception_status) (rate(litellm_deployment_successful_fallbacks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Successful Fallbacks

panels.description: Requests where both the primary and every fallback failed, so the client got an error

targets.expr: sum by (requested_model, fallback_model, exception_status) (rate(litellm_deployment_failed_fallbacks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failed Fallbacks

panels.description: Requests rejected by the router before reaching any provider (empty api_base): context window exceeded, budget checks and other pre-call checks. These count as failures for the model group but are served by fallback when one exists; they are not provider errors

targets.expr: sum by (requested_model, exception_class, exception_status) (rate(litellm_deployment_failure_responses_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", api_base="", requested_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Router-side Rejections (pre-call checks)

panels.description: Failures from requests that did reach a provider deployment (non-empty api_base). Compare with Router-side Rejections: only these are real provider errors
panels.title: Provider Failures per Endpoint

panels.description: Request size distribution by prompt tokens, using the input_sequence_length label on the LLM API latency histogram. Requires prometheus_emit_input_sequence_length_label: true in litellm_settings. Only successful requests are counted

targets.expr: sum by (input_sequence_length) (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model", input_sequence_length=~".+"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request Size Distribution (input tokens)
